$comment: draft v0 — WO-048. Shape of releases.json in a private deploy repository (digimenu-deploy-<city>). It lists the releases bundled into one production deployment. Café pins are NOT stored here: they are data in the database. See docs/architecture/releases.md.
title: DigiMenu release window
description: At most 3 immutable releases deployed together: at most one 'previous', one 'stable' and one 'candidate'. Normal operation uses 2 (stable + candidate).

version.description: Release version; the git tag is v<version> in the public toolkit repository.

platformApi.description: Must match the platform shell of the deployment, or the deploy is refused.

commit.description: Toolkit commit the release is built from. Without it, the deploy builds from the tag v<version>.

dataSchema.description: Database migrations: min is the one the release was built against (its manifest's dataSchema; it needs at least that one), max the newest it was checked with. Migrations only add (expand, then contract), so a release keeps working on a newer database until a MAJOR release says otherwise. Every release in the window must accept the current one.

artifactSha256.description: SHA-256 of the release's files, as tools/release/window.js digest prints it for r/<version>/. The deploy rebuilds the release from its commit or tag and refuses a different digest: what runs is what Ahmed approved.

approval.description: Ahmed approves every release before it reaches a café (D-021). The approving run records who approved; no names here.

run.description: Link to the approved production workflow run.
